top_signals.title: Amanda Staveley: The UK Dealmaker With a Passion for Football Ownership
top_signals.summary:
Amanda Staveley has spent decades connecting Middle East investors with Britain's biggest dealmaking opportunities. On Leaders with Francine Lacqua, the PCP Capital Partners chief executive describes how she started out, the negotiations behind the Manchester City and Newcastle United deals and the historic rescue of Barclays during the financial crisis.
This interview was recorded before Bloomberg and others reported that a consortium led by Amanda Staveley has agreed to buy a 25% stake in English club West Ham United for £150 million. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: An Alaska-based tidal energy company is testing a new kind of small, modular turbine in the waters off of Massachusetts to try to take advantage of the United States’ vast and untapped tidal power potential. The turbine is being piloted in the strong tidal currents of Cape Cod to test the technology’s performance and durability in real-world conditions in order to explore whether it could be suitable for commercial scaling.
